default_policy.parallel_policy: Read-only work may run in parallel. Mutating parallelism requires coordinator-approved isolated worktrees, explicit patch integration and fresh integration review; no shared-file writers.
default_policy.checkpoint_rule: Every accepted implementation slice is integrated, usable without a later task, and no worse on the protected baseline. Missing mandatory device evidence blocks checkpoint acceptance.
default_policy.test_execution: LOCAL_FIRST; GitHub Actions is not required. Routine safe checks run locally; live device actions need separately bounded authorization.

branch_policy.fresh_start: Fetch the named base branch at execution time. Use its fetched tip unless the local named base is a strict descendant; in that case preserve and use the local tip. Divergence blocks setup.
branch_policy.resume: Keep the recorded base and existing work branch; verify ancestry and source evidence. Do not refork or automatically merge a moving base.
